module

public import CatalanCore.Uniform.Content.UFSimple.WrapCheck
public import CatalanCore.Uniform.Content.UFSimple.PrefixBranches

public import CatalanCore.Uniform.Bank.FifthsContent.Level3Data.U1
public import CatalanCore.Uniform.Bank.FifthsContent.Level3Data.U2
public import CatalanCore.Uniform.Bank.FifthsContent.Level3Data.U3
public import CatalanCore.Uniform.Bank.FifthsContent.Level3Data.U4

@[expose] public section
set_option Elab.async false
set_option maxRecDepth 100000

/-! # Data: the fifths UF bank for the bank check (lane C1L)

Generated by `scripts/claude/bank/check/emit_bank_uf.py fifths`: the header `bankHead` (`AutoData/Head`) with the
templates of `AutoData/U<j>` and the finite content constant `Λ_fin` (prefix truncation `n = 150`).  The template
checks transport from `bankHead` (`tmplOK_withTmpls`); `bank_check : check bankData = true`. -/

namespace CatalanCore.Uniform.Bank.FifthsContent.Level3Auto
open CatalanCore.Uniform.Content.BankShared.Check

/-- The fifths UF bank data, with its finite `Λ_fin`. -/
def bankData : BankData := { bankHead with Λ := qq  , tmpls := [(1, tmpl1), (2, tmpl2), (3, tmpl3), (4, tmpl4)] }

theorem tmpl1_okD : tmplOK bankData 1 tmpl1 = true :=
  tmplOK_withTmpls bankHead _ _ 1 tmpl1 tmpl1_ok

theorem tmpl2_okD : tmplOK bankData 2 tmpl2 = true :=
  tmplOK_withTmpls bankHead _ _ 2 tmpl2 tmpl2_ok

theorem tmpl3_okD : tmplOK bankData 3 tmpl3 = true :=
  tmplOK_withTmpls bankHead _ _ 3 tmpl3 tmpl3_ok

theorem tmpl4_okD : tmplOK bankData 4 tmpl4 = true :=
  tmplOK_withTmpls bankHead _ _ 4 tmpl4 tmpl4_ok

/-- The catalogue of `bankData` in the shape of `catValid_bankUFwP`. -/
theorem bankData_cat : bankData.cat = ((tableT ++ ([brLP1, brLP2w, brRank, brS] ++
    bankWins.map (fun w => brWin w.1 w.2)) ++ (bankPres.map (fun x => brPre x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2))) ++ [CatalanCore.Uniform.Content.UFSimple.WrapCheck.brWrap]) ++ CatalanCore.Uniform.Content.UFSimple.prefixBranches 24 :=
  by
  simp only [bankData, bankHead, bankExtra, BankData.cat, List.append_assoc]

set_option profiler true in
theorem bank_params : checkParams bankData = true := by decide +kernel

set_option profiler true in
theorem bank_classes : bankData.members.all (classOK bankData) = true := by decide +kernel

theorem bank_tmpls : bankData.tmpls.all (fun x => tmplOK bankData x.1 x.2) = true := by
  show [(1, tmpl1), (2, tmpl2), (3, tmpl3), (4, tmpl4)].all (fun x => tmplOK bankData x.1 x.2) = true
  simp only [List.all_cons, List.all_nil, tmpl1_okD, tmpl2_okD, tmpl3_okD, tmpl4_okD, Bool.and_self]

/-- **The bank check accepts the fifths UF data.** -/
theorem bank_check : check bankData = true := by
  unfold check
  rw [bank_params, bank_tmpls, bank_classes]
  rfl

/-- The finite content constant. -/
theorem bankData_Λ : bankData.Λ = ( /
     : ℚ) := by
  decide +kernel

end CatalanCore.Uniform.Bank.FifthsContent.Level3Auto
